hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in */docs/decisions/README.md) exit 0;; */docs/decisions/*) if [ -e "$f" ]; then echo "$f is an Architecture Decision Record: point-in-time history that is not edited. Record a change of decision in a new ADR (and list it in docs/decisions/README.md), or ask the user to confirm this edit." >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; exit 0
f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); case "$f" in *.js|*.mjs|*.cjs) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/biome" check --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; exit 0
